indicators.title: Global Food Prices · year-over-year
indicators.context: How fast the IMF's global food commodity index is rising versus a year ago — the upstream driver of grocery inflation.
indicators.read: Food costs are rising 30.2% a year — acute pressure on households.

indicators.title: Copper · “Dr. Copper”
indicators.context: The global price of copper ($/metric ton) — nicknamed “Dr. Copper” for its knack of signalling the direction of the global economy.
indicators.read: Copper is up 41% from a year ago, now 13,484.
indicators.no_severity_reason: A market price has no inherent good-or-bad level — higher or lower isn't itself better or worse.

indicators.title: Broad Commodities · year-over-year
indicators.context: How fast the IMF's all-commodity price index is rising versus a year ago — a single gauge of raw-input cost pressure across the economy.
indicators.read: The broad commodity index is rising 0.8% a year.
indicators.no_severity_reason: A market price has no inherent good-or-bad level — higher or lower isn't itself better or worse.
